title: Passiontide Meditation | Organ Giants | J.S. Bach Complete Organ Works Recital 6 | William Fox
description:
To view an order of service, please click here: https://www.stpauls.co.uk/worship-music/music/concerts-and-events/sunday-organ-recitals

The Passiontide Organ Meditation forms part of the annual observance of Lent, Holy Week, and Easter at St Paul’s. This year, the service is comprised of readings from Sacred Scripture and selected organ music by J.S. Bach. 

The Meditation also forms part of the continuation of ‘Organ Giants’, a two year long organ recital series to celebrate 150 years of the Willis heart of the Grand Organ of St Paul's. This Meditation is the sixth instalment of 30 recitals of complete organ works of J.S. Bach, played by our Sub Organist, William Fox. 

This service is being streamed from an empty building and behind closed doors, and is compliant with current COVID-19 guidance.​
